Skill version 1.0.1 — Major update with improved user privacy and streamlined workflow:

- User identity (open-id) management is now fully automatic and handled internally—users are no longer prompted to provide or see identity values.
- Streamlined usage flow: all user identity linkage, including for history queries, is transparent and automatic.
- Documentation and workflow updated to emphasize fully internalized authentication, with prior open-id request steps and user prompts removed.
- Strict enforcement that all history report queries fetch from the cloud API only; local/memory/aggregation is absolutely forbidden.
- More concise, visually structured SKILL.md, with improved parameter guidance and demo resource.
- One obsolete script file removed; improved modularity and clarity in supporting scripts.

Initial release of smyx-aquarium-plant-health-monitor-analysis.

- Monitors aquarium plant health using AI vision analysis on camera images or videos.
- Detects leaf color changes (yellowing, bleaching, blackening), morphological anomalies (melting, curling, holes), and iron deficiency in submerged plants.
- Outputs structured health assessment and care suggestions (e.g., supplement iron, adjust lighting, increase CO₂), focusing on early problem detection and ecological balance.
- Supports automatic saving and listing of historical reports, with strict open-id authentication for API calls.
- Designed for use in smart fish tanks, aquascaping tanks, and aquarium shops.
